delivery.title: Delivery Zones
delivery.desc: We deliver to Dely Ibrahim, Cheraga, Ouled Fayet, and El Biar. Typical delivery time: 25-40 mins.

hours.title: Visit Hours
hours.desc: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Weekends we stay open until midnight for late-night cravings.

questions.a: We are situated in the heart of Dely Ibrahim, Algiers. Our exact address is Rue 11 Decembre 1960. You can find an interactive map on our Location page.
We are open daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM. On weekends, we often stay open until midnight to satisfy your late-night cravings.

questions.q: How can I place an order?
questions.a: You can browse our menu, add items to your cart, and checkout right here on our website. The final order is sent via WhatsApp to our kitchen for immediate preparation.
Yes, we offer fast delivery within Dely Ibrahim and surrounding areas including Cheraga and Ouled Fayet. Delivery is typically free for orders above a certain amount.
Absolutely. We pride ourselves on using 100% fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Our meat is prepared daily, and our vegetables are delivered every morning.
Yes! While we are famous for our 'Crousty' meats, we have a selection of delicious desserts and can customize some items to be vegetarian-friendly. Look for the 'Sweet' category in our menu.
